description:
The 4StoreyBuilding.inp project is open in eQUEST 3.65. You are working on a building energy model for a site in a heavy snow-belt region (Buffalo, NY). The current model uses a default constant ground reflectance (albedo) of 0.2, which underestimates solar reflection during winter months.

Your task is to update the 'Ground Reflectance' parameter in the Project/Site Parameters to use seasonal values instead of a single annual average. Configure the following monthly reflectance values:
- Winter (January, February, December): 0.60 (Snow cover)
- Shoulder (March): 0.40 (Melting snow/mix)
- Base (April through November): 0.20 (Standard ground/grass)

After updating the parameters, you must run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to capture the impact on solar heat gain and daylighting. Save the project when complete.
